problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. The packages are:
* Package Alpha: weight 42kg
* Package Beta: weight 68kg
* Package Gamma: weight 66kg
* Package Delta: weight 37kg
* Package Epsilon: weight 55kg
* Package Zeta: weight 35kg
* Package Eta: weight 53kg
* Package Theta: weight 37kg
* Package Iota: weight 32kg
* Package Kappa: weight 68kg
* Package Lambda: weight 31kg

Each truck has a maximum load capacity of 100 kg. Assign all packages using the fewest trucks possible. Every package must be placed on exactly one truck, and the total weight loaded onto any truck must not exceed its capacity.
